test_cases.name: Customer Successful Registration
test_cases.description: Verify that a new customer can successfully register an account with valid information and receive customer-level permissions.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The customer account is created successfully, confirmation is displayed/sent, and customer can log in with customer-level access.

test_cases.name: Registration with Duplicate Email
test_cases.description: Verify that registration fails when an email already in the system is used.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Registration is rejected with a validation error indicating the email is already registered.

test_cases.name: Customer Privilege Escalation Attempt during Registration
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer cannot assign themselves administrative privileges during registration.
test_cases.expected_outcome: System assigns the default 'Customer' role or rejects the request; the user does not gain admin privileges.

test_cases.name: View Available Services as Customer
test_cases.description: Verify that an authenticated customer can view the full list of active salon services with details and pricing.
test_cases.expected_outcome: List of active services (e.g., Haircut, Color, Manicure) is displayed with descriptions, durations, and prices.

test_cases.name: Customer Access to Admin Service Configuration
test_cases.description: Verify that customer users cannot edit, add, or delete salon services, strictly restricted to viewing.
test_cases.expected_outcome: System returns HTTP 403 Forbidden, preventing unauthorized service creation.

test_cases.name: Select Available Future Appointment Slot
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer can select an open appointment slot for an active service.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The slot is selected and held for the customer to proceed to booking/payment.

test_cases.name: Select Already Booked Appointment Slot
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer cannot select an appointment slot that is already booked by another user.
test_cases.expected_outcome: System shows an error that the selected time slot is unavailable.

test_cases.name: Appointment Time at Earliest Valid Booking Boundary
test_cases.description: Verify booking behavior exactly at opening time boundary versus before opening time.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The 09:00:00Z slot is available for booking, whereas the 08:59:00Z slot is unavailable.

test_cases.name: Successful Online Payment for Appointment
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer can successfully pay online for a booked appointment using a valid payment method.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Payment is processed successfully, payment status is updated to 'Paid', and receipt is generated.

test_cases.name: Online Payment with Declined Card
test_cases.description: Verify proper error handling when the online payment transaction is declined by the gateway.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Payment fails with an appropriate error message; appointment status remains unpaid/pending.

test_cases.name: Payment Boundary Value - Minimum Valid and Invalid Amounts
test_cases.description: Verify payment boundaries around zero amount and minimum valid transaction amount.
test_cases.expected_outcome: 0.00 and -0.01 amounts are rejected as invalid payment values; valid positive amounts matching service price are accepted.

test_cases.name: Customer Successfully Cancels Own Appointment
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer can cancel their own upcoming appointment.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Appointment status changes to 'Cancelled' and slot becomes available again.

test_cases.name: Customer Attempts to Cancel Another Customer's Appointment
test_cases.description: Verify authorization checks prevent a customer from cancelling an appointment owned by another customer.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Request is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden or not found, appointment remains active.

test_cases.name: Cancel Appointment Already In Past or Cancelled
test_cases.description: Verify boundary handling when attempting to cancel an appointment whose start time has just passed.
test_cases.expected_outcome: System prevents cancellation of an appointment that has already started or elapsed.
